title: Initialization Error with Missing Tool Result Block
body:
**Bug Description**
cannot run init command. get the folllowing error:  API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.2: Did not find 1 `tool_result` block(s) at the beginning of this message. Messages following `tool_use` blocks must begin with a matching number of `tool_result` blocks."}}

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: 6c206814-afba-46a6-9a30-120a2fcfd964
author: paymog
